claim_boundary: One public same-operator trial only; no independent or generalized capability, production performance, user completion, or AGI claim.

eligibility: Public Python project with permissive local analysis license and existing official tests.
Open reported regression with a concrete public reproduction or failing-test description.
No secret, paid service, account-holder-only setup, network test side effects or upstream writes required.
No previously accessed solution commit, PR diff, or patch in this trial.
selection.order: repository manifest order, then issue creation ascending and number ascending
selection.solution_access: Do not open linked fix/solution PRs or commits. Exclude a body that itself supplies a patch; preserve contamination observation without using it.

trial.repository_source_lock: Record latest source commit and issue identity, required commands and environment before any baseline run.
trial.verdict: PASS only with reproduced baseline failure, single patch fixing it, all locked required official tests passing, no protected regression and complete provenance; otherwise FAIL/NOT_EVALUABLE/UNCERTAIN.
